title: Exquisite Gift Of Eggness
body:
"Egg. I love egg. Yes. Openable on May 14, 2 PM EST"

Description

The Exquisite Gift Of Eggness was a limited Easter event item available at the in game Easter shop for $65,780.

You could buy it in the new Easter shack, Eggcelent Deals, and it left the game on May 14th.

Once unboxed, it gives the item "Fancy Eg", which is a white egg with a top hat, monocle, the "Shiny Teeth" face and 2 legs with 3 pivot points each.
